Method of Attack: Logical flaw in npm registry allowing attackers to add any number of users as maintainers without their consent, boosting trust in malicious packages
Attackers add credible developers and popular companies as maintainers to malicious packages to lend credibility
Attackers can remove themselves after adding maintainers, leaving only legitimate accounts associated with malicious packages
Discoverer: Yakir Kadkoda (security researcher at Aqua's Team Nautilus)
Attack Vector: Adding maintainers to malicious packages without their consent via npm registry logical flaw
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious packages with added maintainers from credible developers or companies such as Facebook (Meta) and npm accounts without their consent
